entities.summary: Christophe Louis Yves Georges Pierre is a French Catholic prelate and diplomat who served as Apostolic Nuncio to the United States from 2016 to 2026. He previously served as apostolic nuncio to Mexico, Uganda, and Haiti. He was made a cardinal in 2023.
